config.resize: letterbox (keep aspect ratio, centre, pad with gray)
config.output_format: DD L DDD DD without separators, e.g. '12ب34567' (last two digits = region code; alef is written 'الف')
config.label_normalization: lpr_models.normalize_label (removes ZWJ/ZWNJ/spaces, Persian digits -> ASCII, Arabic yeh/kaf -> Persian)
